relationships.subject: TRPV1+ sensory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: accumulative studies have revealed that TRPV1-expressing (TRPV1<sup>+</sup>) sensory neurons mediate the neuroimmune crosstalk by releasing neuropeptides to innervated tissues as well as immune cells

key_findings: Review: TRPV1 and TRPV1+ sensory neurons transmit pain and itch signals and mediate neuroimmune crosstalk and neurogenic inflammation via neuropeptide release.
